# TildaZ v0.10.2

**Change the text size while TildaZ runs, TildaZ works on GNOME 51, and the AppImage keeps autostart working.**

- Change the text size with `Ctrl+Shift+=` / `Ctrl+Shift+-`, and `Ctrl+Shift+Backspace` to go back (`Cmd+=` / `Cmd+-` / `Cmd+0` on macOS). ([#679](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/679))
- GNOME 51: the Shell extension loads again. Without it TildaZ stopped with "Shell Extension Required". ([#710](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/710))
- AppImage: autostart, menu entries and the COSMIC hotkey stopped working once TildaZ quit — they pointed at a temporary folder. They now point at the AppImage file, and on GNOME the extension starts it at login. ([#706](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/706) · [#707](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/707))
- sway and Hyprland: autostart now works with every Linux package, not only the tarball. ([#701](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/701))
- COSMIC: your own custom shortcuts are no longer broken when TildaZ registers its hotkey. ([#681](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/681))

## Upgrade notes

- Linux tarball: install with `./install.sh --release`. ([#654](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/654))
- GNOME and Cinnamon now require the TildaZ Drop-down Shell extension. If you turned it off, turn it on in Extensions and start TildaZ again. ([#676](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/676))
- sway and Hyprland: the first time you start TildaZ in that session, it adds one line to your config that loads `~/.config/sway/tildaz.conf` or `~/.config/hypr/tildaz.lua`, and tells you once. If you delete the line, TildaZ won't add it back. ([#700](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/700) · [#701](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/701))
- COSMIC: TildaZ backs up your shortcuts file before editing it, to `~/.local/state/tildaz/backup/`. ([#700](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/700))
- New `[keys]` actions `increase_font_size`, `decrease_font_size`, `reset_font_size` and `open_shortcuts`. Your config does not have them yet, so the startup notice lists them until you add them. ([#679](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/679) · [#682](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/682))
- macOS: log files moved to `~/Library/Logs/tildaz/`. ([#654](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/654))
- macOS: the auto-start entry has a new name and the old one is not removed. If TildaZ starts twice at login, run once: `launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.tildaz.app 2>/dev/null; rm -f ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tildaz.app.plist` ([#654](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/654))
